milestones.goal: One county (Panola) audited end to end from the command line: scan read, sums checked, failing cells re-read, public file audited, findings and corrected file written
The second layout, all eight counties unattended, and a measured before and after from one real failure found in the traces
The results page shows a finished run with a finding drawn on the scan
Evidence, security, cleanup, deploy, recording and submission

tasks.title: Scaffold, sources, rendering, ledger and checks
tasks.objective: A uv project whose deterministic core (downloads, page rendering, the SQLite ledger, the row, column and grid checks) works and is tested, with no model call
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot filecheck --all` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL list every row of each published file whose votes differ from the sum of its parts
WHEN `crossfoot render --county panola --page 1` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL write a PNG of that page at 200 dpi
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: Model client, tracing, block finding and the first read of Panola
tasks.objective: Panola's six pages are read block by block into the ledger with a traced, budget-guarded model client, and the checks report which sums hold
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot read --county panola` finishes THE SYSTEM SHALL print cells read, sums passing and sums failing, and write them to the run folder
IF the model's answer is not valid JSON or has the wrong number of columns THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL ask once for a repair and otherwise mark the block failed
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration
tasks.notes: [2026-10-11 done] E0012 to E0014 passed inside the task's session on the code of e21153c; the only changes after that run are the report and the ledger file, so the read was not paid for twice

tasks.title: The first read's failure taken from its trace to a fix, with a run before and a run after
tasks.objective: The cause of the first read's failing sums is found in the traces, fixed, and the read repeated, with both runs' numbers written down
acceptance: WHEN the read after the fix finishes THE SYSTEM SHALL have fewer than 20 of its row sums failing, or the report says what the figure is and why
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; the run before stays in runs/
tasks.notes:
Added 2026-10-11 after T02: the first read fails most sums, so the trace-driven fix comes before the loop instead of after the full run.
[2026-10-11 done] E0019 and the test run passed inside the task's session on the fix commit 338de15; the orchestrator re-ran pytest (28 passed) and checked the report's numbers against both first-read.json files. Acceptance not met and recorded as such: 32 row sums still fail (target under 20); the loop in T03a takes them.

tasks.title: The investigation loop that closes a county's ledger
tasks.objective: `crossfoot close --county panola --resume <run>` works every failing sum until each cell is accepted or cannot_verify, under the rules, and writes county.json
acceptance: IF the stronger model is asked for before two failed re-reads THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commits; committed runs are never changed
tasks.notes:
Split from T03 on 2026-10-11 so each session has one job.
[2026-10-11 done] E0021 (46 tests) and E0022 (the close run 20261011-102700) passed inside the task's session on commit 84c88a8; the orchestrator re-ran pytest (46 passed) and read county.json's summary. The ledger closes, but 16 row, 16 column and 12 grand sums still fail and 335 cells are cannot_verify; recorded as the starting point for the next task.

tasks.title: The reader chosen by measurement; wrong values located where two failing sums cross
tasks.objective: `crossfoot read` picks the model from a measured sample; `crossfoot close` leaves at most 3 sums failing on Panola, each with a verdict
verify: uv run crossfoot close --county panola --resume latest
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commits; committed runs are never changed
tasks.notes:
Added 2026-10-11 after T03a and a scout read: the cheap model plus a blind loop cost more and closed less than one read with the stronger model.
[2026-10-11 done] The verify runs (82 tests; close run 20261011-112935) passed inside the task's session on commit 4fb474a; the orchestrator re-ran pytest (82 passed), checked the report's figures against first-read.json and county.json, and read the document_inconsistent small total on the scan at 600 dpi (it reads 1079; the cells read 818, 44, 214).

tasks.title: The audit against the published file, and the outputs
tasks.objective: `crossfoot audit --county panola` compares the closed ledger with the published file, settles each disagreement with printed totals and writes findings, crops, a corrected file, a diff and a report
verify: uv run crossfoot audit --county panola --resume latest
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commits; committed runs are never changed
tasks.notes:
Was T03b before 2026-10-11 11:15 UTC.
[2026-10-11 done] Verify runs passed inside the task's session on commit 110c4df (107 tests; audit --resume latest; verify-known 8 of 8). The orchestrator re-ran pytest (107 passed) and verify-known (8 of 8) and compared the corrected file with printed row totals read by eye: it is NOT yet consistent (8 corrected rows fail their own total; six candidates' sums differ from the printed totals) because a single-value re-read was allowed to unsettle what two printed sums settle. T03d fixes that.

tasks.title: The printed sums decide; the corrected file is checked against every printed sum
tasks.objective: A finding that two printed sums settle stays settled whatever a single-value re-read returns; the corrected file has no row that fails its own total and is scored against every printed sum
acceptance: WHEN a row is corrected THE SYSTEM SHALL leave it consistent with its own total or not correct it
verify: uv run crossfoot audit --county panola --resume latest
tasks.notes: Added 2026-10-11 after the orchestrator compared T03c's corrected file with printed totals read by eye.

tasks.title: The one-precinct-per-page layout, the layout decision, and San Saba audited
tasks.objective: Counties in the report layout are read and audited; the layout is decided per county; a county with no printed totals is left alone
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot audit --county san_saba` finishes THE SYSTEM SHALL list the published file's row that fails its own total
IF a county's layout cannot be decided THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL report it as not supported and leave it alone
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commits; committed runs are never changed

tasks.title: Every county unattended, with a budget, resume and a summary
tasks.objective: `crossfoot audit --all` runs unattended, resumes, stays inside a budget and writes a summary; the full run is made once
acceptance: IF the metered cost would pass the budget THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL stop before the next call and list the counties not reached
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commits; committed runs are never changed
tasks.notes: Split from T04 on 2026-10-11. The full run is made once inside the task and recorded with `pb.py run`.

tasks.title: The one-prompt baseline scored the same way, and the recovery evidence
tasks.objective: The baseline's findings are scored against the audit's ledger with the audit's rules and reported whatever they show; one real recovery is written up from the runs' events
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot score` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL put every claimed disagreement in one of four groups by the audit's own rules
verify: uv run crossfoot score --findings docs/evidence/baseline/findings.json --county panola --resume latest
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration
tasks.notes: Changed 2026-10-11: both before-and-after sections are written by T02a and T03b, so this task scores the baseline (S3) and writes the recovery evidence.
